"ELDORIA: CLASH OF LEGENDS

COMPLETE 3D FIGHTING GAME — BUILD FROM SCRATCH

PROJECT DIRECTIVE

Create a completely new, playable 3D fighting game from scratch.

Do not reuse the previous ELDORIA open-world project, its character models, map, UI, or gameplay implementation.

Create original characters, original arenas, original animations, and original combat systems.

The game should have the depth and responsiveness associated with professional 3D fighting games, with an original fantasy identity. Do not copy copyrighted characters, models, sounds, animations, or assets from existing games.

1. GAME SPECIFICATIONS

- Title: ELDORIA: CLASH OF LEGENDS
- Genre: 3D Fighting / Arena Fighter
- Camera: Third-person follow camera
- Target platforms: Android and PC
- Primary gameplay: 1 vs 1 combat
- Visual style: High-quality realistic fantasy 3D
- Game mode: Single-player versus AI
- Multiplayer: Optional future expansion
- Orientation: Landscape on mobile

2. CHARACTER CREATION

Create at least two completely original playable 3D fighters.

Each character must have:

- Detailed humanoid 3D model.
- Proper body proportions.
- Detailed face, hair, clothing and armor.
- Separate body parts and articulated skeleton.
- Original fighting style.
- Unique combat animations.
- Idle, walk, run, attack, block, dodge, jump and victory animations.
- Hit reaction, stagger and knockback animations.

Characters must not be simple capsules, cubes, or primitive placeholder models.

3. COMBAT SYSTEM

Implement a functional real-time fighting system.

Combat controls:

- Light Attack.
- Heavy Attack.
- Guard.
- Dodge.
- Jump.
- Skill 1.
- Skill 2.
- Skill 3.
- Ultimate Attack.

Combat mechanics:

- Light and heavy attack combinations.
- Directional attacks.
- Combo chains.
- Attack recovery.
- Hit detection.
- Block detection.
- Damage calculation.
- Stun and stagger.
- Knockback.
- Launch and air recovery.
- Dodge invulnerability frames where supported.
- Cooldowns for special abilities.
- Health and stamina management.

Every attack must have actual gameplay logic and hit detection. Do not implement buttons that only trigger visual effects.

4. THIRD-PERSON CAMERA

Create a responsive third-person camera that follows the player.

Requirements:

- Smooth camera follow.
- Adjustable camera distance.
- Target lock on opponent.
- Automatic framing of both fighters.
- Camera rotation.
- Camera collision avoidance.
- No clipping through arena geometry.
- Smooth transitions during combat.
- Both fighters should remain visible during normal combat.

The camera must not obstruct the player's view of attacks.

5. OPPONENT AI

Create an intelligent fighting opponent.

AI behaviors:

- Approach the player.
- Maintain combat distance.
- Attack when appropriate.
- Block incoming attacks.
- Dodge dangerous attacks.
- Use combos.
- Use special abilities.
- Recover from stagger.
- React to the player's behavior.

Provide three difficulty levels:

- Easy.
- Normal.
- Hard.

The AI must actually participate in combat instead of standing still.

6. ARENA ENVIRONMENT

Create at least two original 3D fighting arenas.

Arena examples:

- Ancient medieval castle courtyard.
- Mystical fantasy temple.

Each arena must include:

- Detailed ground materials.
- Background architecture.
- Environmental lighting.
- Shadows.
- Atmospheric effects.
- Decorative objects.
- Proper collision boundaries.

The arenas should feel like real 3D environments, not flat backgrounds.

Add optional destructible or interactive environmental objects if supported.

7. GRAPHICS AND VISUAL EFFECTS

Implement:

- High-quality PBR materials.
- Detailed character textures.
- Dynamic lighting.
- Real-time shadows where supported.
- Ambient occlusion where supported.
- Particle effects.
- Weapon trails.
- Magical energy effects.
- Impact effects.
- Dust and ground effects.
- Screen shake during powerful attacks.
- Smooth animation blending.

Use actual 3D models and materials rather than relying on flat-colored primitives.

8. MOBILE CONTROL SYSTEM

Android touch controls are mandatory.

Left side:

- Fixed virtual joystick.
- Up: move forward.
- Down: move backward.
- Left: move left.
- Right: move right.

Right side:

- Light Attack.
- Heavy Attack.
- Guard.
- Dodge.
- Jump.
- Skill 1.
- Skill 2.
- Skill 3.
- Ultimate.

Requirements:

- All controls must work with touch input.
- Joystick must stay on the left side.
- Combat buttons must stay on the right side.
- Buttons must not overlap.
- Support different Android screen sizes.
- Maintain controls in landscape orientation.
- Support simultaneous movement and attack inputs.
- Add clear visual feedback when buttons are pressed.
- Never display PC keyboard instructions as a replacement for mobile controls.

9. PC CONTROL SYSTEM

Keyboard and mouse controls:

- WASD: Movement.
- Mouse: Camera rotation.
- Left mouse button: Light Attack.
- Right mouse button: Heavy Attack.
- Shift: Dodge.
- Space: Jump.
- Q: Guard.
- E: Skill 1.
- R: Skill 2.
- F: Skill 3.
- G: Ultimate.

Allow control remapping if supported.

10. GAME MODES

Implement:

- Training Mode.
- Player vs AI.
- Character Selection.
- Arena Selection.
- Match Results.
- Rematch.
- Difficulty Selection.

Training mode should provide an opponent that can remain idle or perform basic actions for combat practice.

11. USER INTERFACE

Create a polished fighting game interface.

Include:

- Main menu.
- Character selection screen.
- Arena selection.
- Health bars.
- Stamina bars.
- Skill cooldown indicators.
- Round counter.
- Match timer.
- Victory and defeat screens.
- Pause menu.
- Settings.

The interface must adapt to Android and PC.

12. PERFORMANCE AND OPTIMIZATION

Optimize for Android mid-range hardware and PC.

Implement:

- Level of detail.
- Efficient rendering.
- Optimized textures.
- Adaptive graphics settings.
- Efficient shadow rendering.
- Limited unnecessary particles.
- Efficient animation updates.
- Stable physics simulation.
- Responsive input handling.

Provide Low, Medium and High graphics settings.

Prioritize smooth combat and responsive controls over unnecessary visual effects.

13. DEVELOPMENT ORDER

Build the project in this order:

PHASE 1:

- Create new project.
- Create arena.
- Create two original 3D fighters.
- Implement character movement.
- Implement third-person camera.

PHASE 2:

- Implement hit detection.
- Implement attacks.
- Implement combos.
- Implement blocking and dodging.
- Implement health and damage.

PHASE 3:

- Implement opponent AI.
- Implement special abilities.
- Implement animations.
- Implement match logic.

PHASE 4:

- Implement Android controls.
- Implement PC controls.
- Implement menus and UI.

PHASE 5:

- Improve graphics.
- Add effects and sound.
- Optimize performance.
- Test complete gameplay.

14. ACCEPTANCE TESTS

Before declaring the project complete, verify:

1. Two different 3D fighters can enter an arena.
2. Both fighters have working animations.
3. Player movement works.
4. Camera follows the player correctly.
5. Attacks can hit the opponent.
6. Health decreases when attacks connect.
7. Guard blocks appropriate attacks.
8. Dodge works.
9. Combos work.
10. Opponent AI can fight.
11. Android virtual controls work in landscape.
12. PC keyboard and mouse controls work.
13. Match can end in victory or defeat.
14. Rematch works.
15. Game runs without critical errors.

Do not mark a feature as completed unless it has actually been implemented and tested.

FINAL DIRECTIVE

Build a fully playable 3D fighting game, not a static 3D demonstration.

Focus on responsive combat, detailed original character models, real animations, functional physics and collision, intelligent opponent AI, and reliable Android controls.

If a requested feature exceeds the capabilities of the engine, explain the limitation and implement the best functional alternative.

Do not fake gameplay features with decorative buttons or visual-only effects.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

+# ELDORIA: CLASH OF LEGENDS
+
+A standalone, browser-based 3D arena fighter built with Three.js. All fighters, props, effects, and arenas are original procedural geometry; the project does not reuse the previous open-world project.
+
+## Run
+
+```sh
+npm install
+npm run dev
+```
+
+Open the Vite URL in a modern desktop or mobile browser. On mobile, play in landscape for the intended layout.
+
+## Controls
+
+- **PC:** WASD move, mouse rotate camera (click the arena to capture the pointer), wheel adjusts camera distance, left/right mouse light/heavy, Q guard, Shift dodge/run, Space jump, E/R/F skills, G ultimate, Tab toggles target lock, Escape pauses.
+- **Touch:** left virtual stick moves; right-side buttons attack, guard, dodge, jump, and use skills. Touch buttons can be pressed while the stick is held.
+
+Choose Lyra or Draeven, an arena, versus AI or training, and one of three AI difficulties from the opening menu. The match includes stamina, attack recovery, combo timing, active hit checks, guard damage reduction, dodge invulnerability, knockback, stun, cooldowns, timer, results, rematch, and pause.
+
+## Scope notes
+
+This is a playable prototype, not a production game export. Fighter visuals are assembled from articulated procedural mesh parts and animated procedurally; they are not sculpted, textured character assets with authored skeletal animation clips. Lighting/shadows and the visual detail are tuned for a browser prototype, not high-end realistic fidelity. The included renderer targets WebGL; Android support depends on the browser/GPU. Low/Medium/High presets, remappable controls, sound, and multiplayer are not implemented. Validate on target devices before release.
*** End Patch
